name: rapid-turret
author: MaKyS0
description: Rapid-fire turrets (Rapid I - VI, hand-controllable), five tiers of walls, drills and conveyors, five tiers of Rapid mech units built in the Rapid Forge and five tiers of Rapid air units built in the Rapid Hangar. Pure JSON mod (no Java/JS), so it works on desktop, Android and iOS.
